name: pi
label: Pi
description: Earendil's Pi coding agent for the terminal — headless RPC mode, many providers

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not configured — set a provider API key (press e), or run `pi` and use /login once.
check_ready.unreadable_message: Pi credentials were found but could not be read. Check permissions on ~/.pi/agent, or run `pi` and sign in again.

env_config.name: PI_PROVIDER
env_config.description: Provider: anthropic/openai for native APIs or compatible relays, deepseek for the native DeepSeek API, openai-codex for an existing Pi subscription login, or custom.

env_config.name: PI_MODEL
env_config.description: Exact model id exposed by the provider or relay (for example claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5-codex, or deepseek-v4-flash).

env_config.name: PI_API_FORMAT
env_config.description: API protocol. Keep auto for native providers; choose anthropic-messages, openai-completions, or openai-responses for a relay.

env_config.name: PI_BASE_URL
env_config.description: Optional relay/proxy base URL. Leave blank for the provider's native API. OpenAgents configures Pi automatically when this is set.

env_config.name: PI_API_KEY
env_config.description: API key for the selected provider or relay. Leave blank to reuse an existing Pi /login session.

env_config.name: PI_THINKING
env_config.description: Reasoning effort: off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Leave blank for the model default.

env_config.name: PI_TRUST_PROJECT
env_config.description: Set to 1 to let Pi load project-local .pi/settings.json, extensions and skills from the working directory. OFF by default — project files are executable surface.

tagline: Headless RPC coding agent, many providers.
